subject: Cross type F2 or DO for write_control_file()

messages.author: b3283e6ff2af7edc
messages.subject: Cross type F2 or DO for write_control_file()
parts:
Greetings,

I have GigaMUGA data using F2 hybrids generated from one inbred strain (B6) and one outbred (CD-1). For the write_control_file(), would the appropriate cross type be F2 or DO, and how would I correctly set up this code? 

Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Cross type F2 or DO for write_control_file()
parts:
I don't think R/qtl2 can handle this type of cross at present.

You definitely can't treat it as DO. That is specific for the case of 8
founder strains whose genotypes are known.

You could maybe focus on SNPs that are fixed in the CD-1 population and
are different from B6, and then treat it as a standard F2. But that
would only be reasonable if CD-1 is pretty much inbred, which I expect
is not true.

karl
